title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
description: Design a class initialized with k and an initial array that, after each added value, returns the kth largest element seen so far.

reference.use_case: Continuously reporting the k-th highest value as new data arrives, such as the cutoff score for entering a top-100 leaderboard.
system_examples: Gaming leaderboards — maintaining the score threshold for the top-N
Lucene/Elasticsearch top-hits collection — keeping only the best k scoring documents while scanning matches
Latency alerting — tracking the k-th slowest request in a window as a high-percentile threshold
reference.explanation: A min-heap capped at size k always holds the k-th largest at its root; each new value costs O(log k) and memory stays O(k) regardless of stream length. Bounded heaps are the standard way to keep top-k results in search and ranking.
